necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, continuous rhythm monitoring is indicated to assess for arrhythmic burden and guide anticoagulation management. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code PR-204.
